blocks.zh: 第六章（上篇）— cGMP 廠房佈局策略：產品保護與隔離設計
blocks.en: Chapter 6 (Part A) — cGMP Facility Layout Strategy: Product Protection and Segregation Design

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解生物製藥廠房佈局設計的核心驅動因素，包括 CPPs、CQAs、製程規模與技術選擇。
blocks.en: Understand the core drivers of biopharmaceutical facility layout design, including CPPs, CQAs, process scale and technology selection.

blocks.zh: 掌握生物反應器規模（大/中/小）對廠房平面配置的實際影響，區分垂直堆疊與水平排列設計。
blocks.en: Understand how bioreactor scale (large/medium/small) affects the facility floor plan, and distinguish vertical stack-up from horizontal layout designs.

blocks.zh: 熟悉四種隔離概念（物理、環境、時間、程序），並能判斷各概念的適用情境。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the four segregation concepts (physical, environmental, temporal, procedural) and be able to judge where each applies.

blocks.zh: 理解製程密閉程度如何從根本改變廠房設計策略，從多間潔淨室轉向單一 Ballroom 概念。
blocks.en: Understand how the degree of process closure fundamentally changes facility design strategy, moving from multiple cleanrooms to a single ballroom concept.

blocks.zh: 能夠解讀六個案例（Case 1–6），分析從開放製程到密閉製程的廠房演進邏輯。
blocks.en: Be able to interpret the six cases (Case 1-6) and analyze the design logic behind the evolution from open to closed processing.

blocks.zh: 6.1 Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: 6.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 廠房設計的出發點
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Starting Point of Facility Design

blocks.zh: CPPs（關鍵製程參數）與CQAs（關鍵品質屬性）是廠房設計的最高指導原則。每一個廠房佈局決策——房間數量、氣流方向、走廊配置——都應追溯到「這樣設計如何保護產品的關鍵品質屬性？」這個問題。
blocks.en: CPPs (critical process parameters) and CQAs (critical quality attributes) are the highest guiding principles of facility design. Every layout decision (number of rooms, airflow direction, corridor arrangement) should be traceable to the question: "How does this design protect the product's critical quality attributes?"

blocks.zh: 設計階段的成果不是一套圖紙，而是一個保護策略的實體化。廠房的牆壁、門、壓力梯度，都是保護 CQAs 的工具。
blocks.en: The output of the design phase is not a set of drawings but a physical embodiment of the protection strategy. The walls, doors and pressure gradients of the facility are all tools for protecting CQAs.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 廚房設計決定料理品質
blocks.en: Analogy — Kitchen Design Determines Food Quality

blocks.zh: 想像一家高級餐廳的廚房設計。主廚（CPP/CQA）決定了廚房需要：隔開生熟食區（隔離）、專用刀具架（防交叉汙染）、冷藏溫度監控（環境管控）。廚房設計必須服務於料理品質，而非反過來讓廚師遷就廚房格局。
blocks.en: Think of the kitchen design of a high-end restaurant. The head chef (the CPP/CQA) determines what the kitchen needs: separate raw and cooked food areas (segregation), dedicated knife racks (prevention of cross-contamination), and cold-storage temperature monitoring (environmental control). The kitchen must serve the quality of the food, rather than forcing the chef to adapt to the kitchen layout.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房設計亦同：產品特性決定廠房設計，而非廠房決定產品製程。
blocks.en: Biopharmaceutical facility design works the same way: product characteristics determine the facility design, not the other way around.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 彈性、適應性、擴充性
blocks.en: Key Point — Flexibility, Adaptability, Expandability

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確將 Flexibility（彈性）、Adaptability（適應性）、Expandability（擴充性） 列為關鍵設計驅動因素。這對 CDMO 尤為重要：
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly lists Flexibility, Adaptability and Expandability as key design drivers. This is particularly important for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 彈性：同一廠房可生產不同客戶的產品
blocks.en: Flexibility: the same facility can manufacture products for different clients

blocks.zh: 適應性：製程改變時廠房能以低成本調整
blocks.en: Adaptability: the facility can be modified at low cost when the process changes

blocks.zh: 擴充性：從臨床批次擴大到商業化生產無需另建廠房
blocks.en: Expandability: scale-up from clinical batches to commercial production without building a separate facility

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若一個生物製藥產品的 CQA 要求低生物負荷（low bioburden），這對廠房佈局的氣流設計有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If a biopharmaceutical product has a CQA requiring low bioburden, how does this affect the airflow design of the facility layout?

blocks.zh: 疫苗設施為何需要特別考慮「生物安全要求」？這與傳統小分子藥物有何不同？
blocks.en: Why do vaccine facilities need to give special consideration to "biosafety requirements"? How does this differ from conventional small-molecule drugs?

blocks.en: 6.2 Production Capacity, Process, Scale and Technologies

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 從產能需求到廠房設計的推導鏈
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Derivation Chain from Capacity Requirements to Facility Design

blocks.zh: ISPE 提出了一個完整的設計推導邏輯：
blocks.en: ISPE presents a complete design derivation logic:

blocks.zh: 商業目標（年產量）→ BFD/PFD → 設備清單 → 物料衡算 → 廠房佈局
blocks.en: Business objective (annual output) → BFD/PFD → equipment list → material balance → facility layout

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞見：製程密閉程度（degree of closure）在此階段就必須決定，因為它直接決定了後續所需的潔淨室等級和房間數量。密閉程度越高，所需的受管控空間越少，廠房可以設計得更簡單、更便宜。
blocks.en: Key insight: the degree of closure of the process must be decided at this stage, because it directly determines the cleanroom grades and number of rooms required later. The higher the degree of closure, the less controlled space is needed, and the simpler and cheaper the facility can be.

blocks.zh: 規模比較 Scale Comparison
blocks.en: Scale Comparison

blocks.zh:
相同總產能 = 12,000 L 的兩種方案：

方案 A：1 × 12,000 L 生物反應器
  → 高樓層廠房（垂直堆疊）
  → 需要強結構支撐與重型起重設備
  → 適合商業化大規模生產

方案 B：6 × 2,000 L 生物反應器
  → 水平排列廠房（單層或低樓層）
  → 可搭配一次性耗材（SU）
  → 更靈活，適合多產品 CDMO

規模分類：
  大規模：10,000 - 30,000 L（垂直堆疊）
  中規模：4,000 - 8,000 L（垂直或水平）
  小規模：≤2,000 L（水平排列）
blocks.en:
Two options for the same total capacity of 12,000 L:

Option A: 1 × 12,000 L bioreactor
  → Multi-story facility (vertical stack-up)
  → Requires strong structural support and heavy lifting equipment
  → Suited to large-scale commercial production

Option B: 6 × 2,000 L bioreactors
  → Horizontal layout (single or low-rise floors)
  → Can be combined with single-use (SU) consumables
  → More flexible, suited to multi-product CDMOs

Scale classification:
  Large scale: 10,000 - 30,000 L (vertical stack-up)
  Medium scale: 4,000 - 8,000 L (vertical or horizontal)
  Small scale: ≤2,000 L (horizontal layout)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 一台大型釀酒槽 vs. 多台小型釀酒槽
blocks.en: Analogy — One Large Brewing Tank vs. Several Small Brewing Tanks

blocks.zh: 想像一個啤酒廠：一台 12,000 公升的大釀酒槽需要高天花板廠房、特殊起重設備和強化地板；六台 2,000 公升的小槽則可在普通廠房水平排列，更靈活但管理成本較高。
blocks.en: Imagine a brewery: one 12,000 L brewing tank needs a building with a high ceiling, special lifting equipment and a reinforced floor; six 2,000 L tanks can be laid out horizontally in an ordinary building, which is more flexible but costs more to manage.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房面臨相同的取捨：大規模單一設備 vs. 小規模多線並行，兩者的廠房設計方式截然不同。
blocks.en: Biopharmaceutical facilities face the same trade-off: a single large-scale unit vs. several small-scale parallel lines. The facility design approaches for the two are completely different.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — MAb 產業趨勢
blocks.en: Key Point — MAb Industry Trends

blocks.zh: ISPE 指出業界趨勢是 MAb 生產規模持續增大，但同時細胞培養效價（titer）的提升讓同等產能可用更小的生物反應器達成。這代表：
blocks.en: ISPE notes that the industry trend is toward ever larger MAb production scales, but at the same time increases in cell culture titer allow the same output to be achieved with smaller bioreactors. This means:

blocks.zh: 新廠設計需考慮未來工藝改進後的彈性
blocks.en: New facility designs must allow for flexibility after future process improvements

blocks.zh: 預留 CNC（Controlled Not Classified）空間比固定潔淨室更具未來彈性
blocks.en: Reserving CNC (Controlled Not Classified) space offers more future flexibility than fixed cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 一次性耗材（Single-Use）技術搭配小規模生物反應器是 CDMO 首選策略
blocks.en: Single-use technology combined with small-scale bioreactors is the preferred strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 為何大規模生物反應器（>10,000 L）傾向採用垂直堆疊設計？重力在哪些製程步驟中發揮作用？
blocks.en: Why do large-scale bioreactors (>10,000 L) tend to use a vertical stack-up design? In which process steps does gravity play a role?

blocks.zh: 作為一個 CDMO，你會傾向選擇大規模單槽還是多台小槽設計？請從商業靈活性角度說明。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, would you favor a single large tank or several small tanks? Explain from the standpoint of commercial flexibility.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 垂直堆疊廠房的五層結構
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Five-Level Structure of a Vertical Stack-up Facility

blocks.zh: 大規模生物製藥廠房的垂直堆疊邏輯遵循重力輔助製程流動原則：
blocks.en: The vertical stack-up logic of a large-scale biopharmaceutical facility follows the principle of gravity-assisted process flow:

blocks.zh: 最高層（L3）：秤重/分裝、培養基與緩衝液配製 → 液體往下流
blocks.en: Top level (L3): weighing/dispensing, media and buffer preparation → liquids flow downward

blocks.zh: 中層（L2）：種菌培養鏈（seed train）、緩衝液暫存
blocks.en: Middle level (L2): seed train, buffer hold

blocks.zh: 生產層（L1）：生物反應器、收穫、純化、原料藥充填
blocks.en: Production level (L1): bioreactors, harvest, purification, drug substance filling

blocks.zh: 公用設施層（地下）：CIP/SIP、純水、壓縮空氣
blocks.en: Utility level (below grade): CIP/SIP, purified water, compressed air

blocks.zh: 頂層（HVAC penthouse）：空調機組
blocks.en: Roof level (HVAC penthouse): air handling units

blocks.zh: 這種五層設計雖然充分利用重力，但建設成本高且未來改造困難。
blocks.en: Although this five-level design makes full use of gravity, it is expensive to build and difficult to modify in the future.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 種菌培養鏈如同工廠育苗室
blocks.en: Analogy — The Seed Train Is Like a Plant Nursery

blocks.zh: 種菌培養鏈（Seed Train）就像農場的育苗溫室：從少量種子（工作細胞庫 Working Cell Bank）開始，在溫控環境中逐步擴大培養量，最終移入生產溫室（生產生物反應器）。
blocks.en: The seed train is like a farm's seedling greenhouse: starting from a small amount of seed (the working cell bank), the culture volume is expanded step by step in a temperature-controlled environment and finally moved into the production greenhouse (the production bioreactor).

blocks.zh: 在廠房設計上，種菌培養鏈通常位於生產反應器的上一樓層或相鄰房間，確保接種操作路徑最短、汙染風險最低。
blocks.en: In facility design, the seed train is usually located on the floor above the production bioreactor or in an adjacent room, so that the inoculation route is shortest and the contamination risk is lowest.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 一次性耗材（SU）的空間優勢
blocks.en: Key Point — The Space Advantage of Single-Use (SU) Systems

blocks.zh: 小規模廠房使用一次性耗材（Single-Use / SU 技術）的核心優勢在於大幅減少廠房佔地面積：
blocks.en: The core advantage of single-use (SU) technology in a small-scale facility is that it greatly reduces the facility footprint:

blocks.zh: 無需固定不鏽鋼管路 → 減少管路間距要求
blocks.en: No fixed stainless steel piping → lower piping spacing requirements

blocks.zh: 緩衝液儲袋（Biocontainer bag）可直接掛在儲存架上 → 大幅縮減緩衝液暫存室面積
blocks.en: Buffer biocontainer bags can hang directly on storage racks → buffer hold room area is greatly reduced

blocks.zh: 整個製程可壓縮至單一生產樓層
blocks.en: The entire process can be compressed onto a single production floor

blocks.zh: 請見後續 Figure 6.4🔍 的面積比較。
blocks.en: See the area comparison in Figure 6.4🔍 below.

blocks.zh: 為何小規模廠房建議盡量縮短軟管（hose/tubing）的長度？過長的軟管在 GMP 上有何風險？
blocks.en: Why is it recommended to keep hoses/tubing as short as possible in a small-scale facility? What are the GMP risks of overly long tubing?

blocks.zh: 一次性耗材（SU bags）在垂直堆疊廠房中是否也適用？為什麼？
blocks.en: Are single-use (SU) bags also suitable in a vertical stack-up facility? Why?

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — In-Line Dilution（在線稀釋）
blocks.en: Core Concept — In-Line Dilution

blocks.zh: 在線稀釋（In-line dilution）是一種革命性的緩衝液管理策略。傳統上，層析純化需要大量不同濃度的緩衝液，每種都需要一個大型儲槽和獨立房間。在線稀釋改為：
blocks.en: In-line dilution is a revolutionary buffer management strategy. Traditionally, chromatography purification requires large volumes of buffers at different concentrations, each needing a large tank and a separate room. In-line dilution instead:

blocks.zh: 僅儲存高濃度緩衝液原液（concentrate）
blocks.en: Stores only concentrated buffer stock (concentrate)

blocks.zh: 在管路中即時按比例混合純水稀釋
blocks.en: Mixes it in the piping in real time with purified water in the required proportion

blocks.zh: 直接輸送到層析柱使用點
blocks.en: Delivers it directly to the chromatography column point of use

blocks.zh: 結果：緩衝液儲存空間可縮減 60–80%，廠房面積大幅縮小。
blocks.en: Result: buffer storage space can be reduced by 60-80%, greatly shrinking the facility footprint.

blocks.zh: 面積節省估算 Footprint Reduction Estimate
blocks.en: Footprint Reduction Estimate

blocks.zh:
緩衝液儲存方案比較（以下游純化為例）：

傳統不鏽鋼儲槽方案：
  典型緩衝液種類：8-12種
  每種需獨立儲槽 + 操作平台
  → 緩衝液儲存區面積：~500-800 m²

一次性耗材（SU bags）方案：
  12-pack bin holder, 12 × 2,500 L = 30,000 L
  → 面積縮減：約 40-60%

在線稀釋 + SU 組合：
  僅需高濃度原液儲存
  → 面積縮減：可達 70-80%

結論：技術選擇直接決定廠房投資金額
blocks.en:
Buffer storage options compared (downstream purification as an example):

Traditional stainless steel tank option:
  Typical number of buffer types: 8-12
  Each needs a separate tank + operating platform
  → Buffer storage area: ~500-800 m²

Single-use (SU bags) option:
  12-pack bin holder, 12 × 2,500 L = 30,000 L
  → Area reduction: about 40-60%

In-line dilution + SU combined:
  Only concentrated stock needs to be stored
  → Area reduction: up to 70-80%

Conclusion: technology selection directly determines the facility capital investment

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 飲料濃縮液 vs. 整箱飲料
blocks.en: Analogy — Beverage Concentrate vs. Cases of Ready-to-Drink Beverages

blocks.zh: 傳統緩衝液儲存如同在倉庫放滿一箱箱已調好的飲料；在線稀釋如同只存放濃縮果汁，臨用前加水稀釋。前者需要巨大倉庫，後者只需一個小架子。
blocks.en: Traditional buffer storage is like filling a warehouse with cases of ready-mixed drinks; in-line dilution is like storing only fruit juice concentrate and adding water just before use. The former needs a huge warehouse, while the latter needs only a small shelf.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 來說，在線稀釋技術不只節省空間，還降低了緩衝液批次間的差異性，有助於減少純化步驟的變異。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, in-line dilution not only saves space but also reduces batch-to-batch buffer variability, which helps reduce variation in purification steps.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 技術選擇建議
blocks.en: Practical Application — Technology Selection Advice for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對於臨床階段（Phase 1–2）的 CDMO 設施：
blocks.en: For a clinical-stage (Phase 1-2) CDMO facility:

blocks.zh: 推薦選擇 SU bags + in-line dilution：初期投資低、廠房面積小、換產快速
blocks.en: Recommended: SU bags + in-line dilution: low initial investment, small footprint, fast changeover

blocks.zh: 避免大規模固定不鏽鋼系統：初期客戶需求不確定，大型固定設備靈活性差
blocks.en: Avoid large-scale fixed stainless steel systems: early client demand is uncertain, and large fixed equipment offers poor flexibility

blocks.zh: 廠房設計應預留未來轉換為不鏽鋼的可能性（管路連接點、地板荷重）
blocks.en: The facility design should leave room for future conversion to stainless steel (piping connection points, floor loading)

blocks.zh: 在線稀釋系統的 GMP 驗證重點是什麼？如何確保每次稀釋比例的精確性？
blocks.en: What are the GMP validation priorities for an in-line dilution system? How can the accuracy of the dilution ratio be ensured every time?

blocks.zh: 一次性耗材的「規模限制」對大規模商業化生產有何影響？
blocks.en: What impact do the "scale limitations" of single-use systems have on large-scale commercial production?

blocks.zh: 6.3 Product Protection and Segregation Applications — 產品保護與隔離應用
blocks.en: 6.3 Product Protection and Segregation Applications

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 生物製藥中的雙重壓力
blocks.en: Key Point — The Dual Pressures in Biopharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房設計面臨兩個相互競爭的保護需求：
blocks.en: Biopharmaceutical facility design faces two competing protection needs:

blocks.zh: 保護產品（Product Protection）：防止環境微生物汙染產品 → 需要潔淨室（正壓、過濾空氣）
blocks.en: Product protection: preventing environmental microorganisms from contaminating the product → requires cleanrooms (positive pressure, filtered air)

blocks.zh: 保護人員/環境（Containment）：防止活性生物製劑外洩 → 需要圍堵設計（負壓、廢氣處理）
blocks.en: Protection of personnel/environment (containment): preventing release of live biological agents → requires containment design (negative pressure, exhaust treatment)

blocks.zh: 決定哪個方向優先的關鍵槓桿：製程密閉程度（Process Closure Level）。密閉製程可以同時解決兩個問題。
blocks.en: The key lever that decides which takes priority is the process closure level. A closed process can solve both problems at the same time.

blocks.zh: 交叉污染（crossover）與殘留污染（carryover）的本質區別是什麼？各自對應的廠房設計解決方案有何不同？
blocks.en: What is the essential difference between crossover and carryover? How do the facility design solutions for each differ?

blocks.zh: 若一個生物製藥製程是完全密閉的，是否仍需要潔淨室？請說明理由。
blocks.en: If a biopharmaceutical process is completely closed, are cleanrooms still needed? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 四種污染來源的對策矩陣
blocks.en: Core Concept — Countermeasure Matrix for the Four Sources of Contamination

blocks.zh: 理解這四種污染來源，才能為每種設計出正確的防護策略，而非對所有情境都採用最嚴格的潔淨室等級。
blocks.en: Only by understanding these four sources of contamination can the right protection strategy be designed for each, rather than applying the strictest cleanroom grade to every situation.

blocks.zh: 6.3.1 Segregation Concepts — 隔離概念
blocks.en: 6.3.1 Segregation Concepts

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 主要隔離 vs. 次要隔離
blocks.en: Core Concept — Primary vs. Secondary Segregation

blocks.zh: Primary Segregation（主要隔離）：針對暴露產品的保護。當產品與房間空氣直接接觸時，必須透過物理隔離（獨立房間）和環境隔離（潔淨室分級）來保護。
blocks.en: Primary segregation: protection for exposed product. When the product is in direct contact with room air, it must be protected through physical segregation (separate rooms) and environmental segregation (cleanroom classification).

blocks.zh: Secondary Segregation（次要隔離）：針對密閉製程的管理。產品已在密閉設備中，隔離的重點轉為防混淆（mix-up）和廢棄物管理。
blocks.en: Secondary segregation: management of closed processes. Once the product is in closed equipment, the focus of segregation shifts to mix-up prevention and waste management.

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞見：引入密閉技術後，主要隔離的需求大幅降低，次要隔離成為主角。
blocks.en: Key insight: once closure technology is introduced, the need for primary segregation falls sharply and secondary segregation becomes the main concern.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 隔離如同醫院隔離病房分級
blocks.en: Analogy — Segregation Is Like Graded Isolation Wards in a Hospital

blocks.zh: 醫院對不同傳染性疾病採用不同隔離等級：
blocks.en: A hospital uses different isolation levels for different infectious diseases:

blocks.zh: 一般病房（CNC）：普通病人，無特殊隔離需求（如密閉製程）
blocks.en: General ward (CNC): ordinary patients, no special isolation needed (like a closed process)

blocks.zh: 半隔離病房（Grade 8）：需防護但傳染性較低（如部分暴露製程）
blocks.en: Semi-isolation ward (Grade 8): protection needed but low infectivity (like some partially exposed processes)

blocks.zh: 負壓隔離病房（Grade 7/5）：高度傳染性病人（如開放暴露的關鍵製程步驟）
blocks.en: Negative-pressure isolation ward (Grade 7/5): highly infectious patients (like open, exposed critical process steps)

blocks.zh: 關鍵在於：不是每個病人都需要負壓隔離。同樣地，不是每個製程步驟都需要 Grade 5 潔淨室。
blocks.en: The key point: not every patient needs negative-pressure isolation. Likewise, not every process step needs a Grade 5 cleanroom.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 物理隔離的關鍵應用
blocks.en: Key Point — Key Applications of Physical Segregation

blocks.zh: 物理隔離最重要的應用是病毒削減步驟（viral reduction）的前後隔離：
blocks.en: The most important application of physical segregation is segregation of the steps before and after viral reduction:

blocks.zh: 開放製程：病毒削減前後必須在獨立房間進行，防止已清除病毒的產品被再次污染
blocks.en: Open process: the steps before and after viral reduction must be carried out in separate rooms, to prevent product that has been cleared of virus from being re-contaminated

blocks.zh: 密閉製程：病毒削減前後可在同一房間進行，因為物理隔離在設備層面已完成
blocks.en: Closed process: the steps before and after viral reduction can be carried out in the same room, because physical segregation is already achieved at the equipment level

blocks.zh: 這個區別在病毒性生物安全評估（Viral Safety Assessment）中極為重要，直接影響法規審查結論。
blocks.en: This distinction is extremely important in the viral safety assessment and directly affects the conclusions of regulatory review.

blocks.zh: 「製程密閉是物理隔離的一種應用」——請用產品轉移管路的例子解釋這句話的含義。
blocks.en: "Process closure is an application of physical segregation." Explain what this statement means, using product transfer piping as an example.

blocks.zh: 為何密閉製程下，病毒削減前後的物料可以使用同一部電梯？監管機構是否會接受這個設計？
blocks.en: Why can pre- and post-viral-reduction materials use the same elevator in a closed process? Would regulators accept this design?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 — 環境、時間與程序隔離
blocks.en: Original Text — Environmental, Temporal and Procedural Segregation

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 壓力梯度如同氣壓迷宮
blocks.en: Analogy — A Pressure Gradient Is Like an Air-Pressure Maze

blocks.zh: 環境隔離中的壓力梯度（Pressure Cascade）設計就像一個氣壓迷宮：空氣永遠從高壓流向低壓。將潔淨區設計為高壓，走廊次之，外部最低，汙染物就無法逆流進入潔淨區。
blocks.en: The pressure cascade design in environmental segregation is like an air-pressure maze: air always flows from high pressure to low pressure. If the cleanroom is designed at the highest pressure, the corridor next, and the outside lowest, contaminants cannot flow back into the cleanroom.

blocks.zh: 但要注意：生物製藥廠房有時需要負壓圍堵（containment）以防止活性生物製劑外洩，此時壓力方向與普通潔淨室相反。這是設計時需特別注意的雙重需求。
blocks.en: Note, however, that biopharmaceutical facilities sometimes need negative-pressure containment to prevent the release of live biological agents; in that case the pressure direction is the opposite of an ordinary cleanroom. This dual requirement needs special attention during design.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Campaign 製造的 GMP 含義
blocks.en: Key Point — GMP Implications of Campaign Manufacturing

blocks.zh: Campaign 製造（Campaigned Manufacturing）是時間隔離最重要的應用。多產品共用廠房時，同一房間在不同時間段分別生產不同產品，中間需要：
blocks.en: Campaigned manufacturing is the most important application of temporal segregation. When several products share a facility, the same room produces different products in different time periods, and between them the following are needed:

blocks.zh: 徹底清潔與清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）
blocks.en: Thorough cleaning and cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 環境監控（EM）確認交叉污染水平
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) to confirm the level of cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 文件確認前後批次的隔離
blocks.en: Documentation confirming segregation between preceding and following batches

blocks.zh: 密閉製程可以實現同一房間多產品同時並行生產，不需要 Campaign，這是密閉系統最大的商業優勢之一。
blocks.en: A closed process makes it possible to produce multiple products simultaneously in the same room without campaigning, which is one of the biggest commercial advantages of closed systems.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 多產品廠房的隔離策略選擇
blocks.en: Practical Application — Choosing a Segregation Strategy for a Multi-Product CDMO Facility

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常同時承接多個客戶的訂單。選擇合適的隔離策略至關重要：
blocks.en: A CDMO usually takes on orders from several clients at the same time. Choosing the right segregation strategy is critical:

blocks.zh: 開放製程：必須採用時間隔離（Campaign）+ 清潔驗證，成本高、彈性低
blocks.en: Open process: must use temporal segregation (campaigning) + cleaning validation; high cost, low flexibility

blocks.zh: 密閉製程：可採用物理隔離（設備層面）+ 同時並行生產，大幅提升廠房產能利用率
blocks.en: Closed process: can use physical segregation (at the equipment level) + simultaneous parallel production, greatly improving facility capacity utilization

blocks.zh: 程序隔離：在洗滌間、廢棄物管理等支援區域廣泛應用，成本最低但風險管理責任最重
blocks.en: Procedural segregation: widely used in support areas such as wash rooms and waste management; lowest cost but carries the greatest risk management responsibility

blocks.zh: 一個更衣室（gowning room）同時用於更衣（gowning）和脫衣（de-gowning），屬於哪種隔離類型？需要什麼管控措施？
blocks.en: A gowning room used for both gowning and de-gowning: which type of segregation is this? What controls are required?

blocks.zh: 當密閉製程存在「短暫開放點」（brief exposure）時，程序隔離的 SOP 應包含哪些要素？
blocks.en: When a closed process has a "brief exposure" point, what elements should the procedural segregation SOP include?

blocks.zh: 6.3.2 Application of Segregation Concepts — 隔離概念的應用
blocks.en: 6.3.2 Application of Segregation Concepts

blocks.zh:
Figure 6.6🔍: Applications of Closure Technology and Segregation
[圖示：Diagram A/B/C 展示密閉技術對隔離需求的影響]
blocks.en:
Figure 6.6🔍: Applications of Closure Technology and Segregation
[Diagram: Diagrams A/B/C showing the effect of closure technology on segregation requirements]

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 三個 Diagram 的演進邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Evolutionary Logic of the Three Diagrams

blocks.zh: Figure 6.6🔍 和 Table 6.1 是本章最核心的學習材料，展示了密閉技術如何逐步「解放」廠房設計：
blocks.en: Figure 6.6🔍 and Table 6.1 are the most important learning material in this chapter. They show how closure technology progressively "liberates" facility design:

blocks.zh: Diagram A（全開放）：整個發酵槽都在潔淨室中。所有四種隔離概念都是最嚴格的：獨立房間、潔淨室分級、Campaign 生產、完整更衣 SOP。
blocks.en: Diagram A (fully open): the entire fermenter is in a cleanroom. All four segregation concepts are at their strictest: separate rooms, cleanroom classification, campaign production and a full gowning SOP.

blocks.zh: Diagram B（部分密閉）：只有取樣點開放，其餘密閉。潔淨室縮小到只包圍取樣區（Alcove）。這是現實中最常見的折衷方案。
blocks.en: Diagram B (partially closed): only the sampling point is open and the rest is closed. The cleanroom shrinks to enclose only the sampling area (alcove). This is the most common compromise in practice.

blocks.zh: Diagram C（完全密閉）：連取樣都密閉。整個房間降為 CNC，可同時並行多產品生產。
blocks.en: Diagram C (fully closed): even sampling is closed. The whole room drops to CNC and multiple products can be produced in parallel at the same time.

blocks.zh: 密閉程度 → 廠房成本的量化關係
blocks.en: Degree of Closure → Facility Cost: A Quantitative Relationship

blocks.zh:
Diagram A（全開放）廠房成本基準：100%

密閉技術降低成本的路徑：
  潔淨室面積縮減  → 建設成本 -20~40%
  更衣間需求減少  → 面積 -10~15%
  HVAC 系統簡化   → 設備成本 -15~25%
  運營成本降低    → 更衣耗材、環境監測 -30~40%

Diagram C（完全密閉）廠房成本：
  約為 Diagram A 的 60~70%

ISPE 案例研究印證：
  Case 1（最開放）vs Case 6（最密閉）
  → Case 1 建設與運營成本約高出 40%
blocks.en:
Diagram A (fully open) facility cost baseline: 100%

How closure technology reduces cost:
  Cleanroom area reduction  → construction cost -20~40%
  Fewer gowning rooms       → area -10~15%
  Simpler HVAC system       → equipment cost -15~25%
  Lower operating cost      → gowning consumables, environmental monitoring -30~40%

Diagram C (fully closed) facility cost:
  About 60~70% of Diagram A

Supported by the ISPE case studies:
  Case 1 (most open) vs Case 6 (most closed)
  → Case 1 construction and operating costs are about 40% higher

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Alcove（凹室）設計如外科手術的局部無菌區
blocks.en: Analogy — The Alcove Design Is Like the Local Sterile Field in Surgery

blocks.zh: Diagram B 的 Alcove 設計就像外科手術室：整個手術室不需要像無菌室一樣維護，但手術台上方的局部區域（無菌手術野）必須維持最高等級的無菌保護。
blocks.en: The alcove design in Diagram B is like a surgical operating room: the whole operating room does not have to be maintained like a sterile room, but the local area above the operating table (the sterile surgical field) must maintain the highest level of sterile protection.

blocks.zh: 同樣地，Alcove 方法只為真正開放的操作點（取樣口）提供局部 HEPA 保護，而不是讓整個發酵間都成為潔淨室，大幅降低設施成本。
blocks.en: Likewise, the alcove approach provides local HEPA protection only for the points that are truly open (the sampling port), rather than making the whole fermentation room a cleanroom, which greatly reduces facility cost.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CNC（Controlled Not Classified）的含義
blocks.en: Key Point — What CNC (Controlled Not Classified) Means

blocks.zh: CNC（Controlled Not Classified，受管控但未分級）是生物製藥廠房獨特的空間等級概念：
blocks.en: CNC (Controlled Not Classified) is a space grade concept unique to biopharmaceutical facilities:

blocks.zh: 空間有基本環境管控（溫濕度、正/負壓、潔淨管理）
blocks.en: The space has basic environmental controls (temperature and humidity, positive/negative pressure, cleanliness management)

blocks.zh: 但不符合 ISO 14644 分級標準（不做粒子計數合規認證）
blocks.en: But it does not meet ISO 14644 classification standards (no particle count compliance certification)

blocks.zh: 適用於所有密閉製程設備所在的空間
blocks.en: Applicable to all spaces housing closed process equipment

blocks.zh: 對比：傳統無菌製藥的 Grade A/B/C/D 是 ISO 分級空間
blocks.en: By contrast: Grade A/B/C/D in conventional sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing are ISO-classified spaces

blocks.zh: 在生物製藥中，CNC 是最常見的製程區域等級，這與傳統小分子無菌藥物（大量使用 Grade B/C）截然不同。
blocks.en: In biopharmaceuticals, CNC is the most common grade for process areas, which is quite different from conventional small-molecule sterile drug products (which make heavy use of Grade B/C).

blocks.zh: Table 6.1 中，從 Diagram A 到 Diagram C，「Flows（流動設計）」的目的發生了什麼變化？這對廠房走廊設計有何影響？
blocks.en: In Table 6.1, what changes in the purpose of "Flows" from Diagram A to Diagram C? How does this affect corridor design?

blocks.zh: Diagram B 的開放取樣點如果改用線上 PAT（Process Analytical Technology）監測，可以升級到 Diagram C 嗎？
blocks.en: If the open sampling point in Diagram B were replaced with online PAT (Process Analytical Technology) monitoring, could it be upgraded to Diagram C?

blocks.zh: 6.3.3 Application of Physical Segregation Concepts — 物理隔離概念的應用
blocks.en: 6.3.3 Application of Physical Segregation Concepts

blocks.zh:
Figure 6.7🔍: Physical Segregation Reassignment (Traditional — Room-based)
[圖示：傳統廠房佈局，每個製程步驟有獨立房間、PAL/MAL]
blocks.en:
Figure 6.7🔍: Physical Segregation Reassignment (Traditional — Room-based)
[Diagram: traditional facility layout, with a separate room, PAL/MAL for each process step]

blocks.zh:
Figure 6.8🔍: Physical Segregation by Equipment (Ballroom concept)
[圖示：密閉製程廠房佈局，拆除隔牆後形成大型彈性生產空間]
blocks.en:
Figure 6.8🔍: Physical Segregation by Equipment (Ballroom concept)
[Diagram: closed-process facility layout, with partition walls removed to form a large flexible production space]

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Ballroom 概念（舞廳概念）
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Ballroom Concept

blocks.zh: Ballroom（或 Dance Floor）是生物製藥廠房設計中的革命性概念：
blocks.en: The ballroom (or dance floor) is a revolutionary concept in biopharmaceutical facility design:

blocks.zh: 將所有密閉製程設備集中在一個大型開放空間中
blocks.en: All closed process equipment is gathered in one large open space

blocks.zh: 整個空間降為 CNC 等級（無需潔淨室認證）
blocks.en: The entire space drops to CNC grade (no cleanroom certification needed)

blocks.zh: 不同設備之間的物理隔離在設備層面完成，而非在房間層面
blocks.en: Physical segregation between different pieces of equipment is achieved at the equipment level, not the room level

blocks.zh: 少數開放操作步驟（如柱填充）則在 Ballroom 旁邊的小型潔淨室中進行，並設置氣閘（Airlock）連接
blocks.en: The few open operations (such as column packing) are carried out in a small cleanroom next to the ballroom, connected by an airlock

blocks.zh: Ballroom 最大優點：廠房靈活性極高，可根據訂單需求重新配置設備。
blocks.en: The biggest advantage of the ballroom: very high facility flexibility, with equipment that can be reconfigured to suit order demand.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 從格子間辦公室到開放式辦公空間
blocks.en: Analogy — From Cubicle Offices to an Open-Plan Office

blocks.zh: 傳統的多房間廠房（圖 6.7）就像 1990 年代的格子間辦公室：每個人被隔牆圍住，溝通效率低，空間利用率差。
blocks.en: The traditional multi-room facility (Figure 6.7) is like a 1990s cubicle office: everyone is enclosed by partitions, communication is inefficient and space utilization is poor.

blocks.zh: Ballroom 概念（圖 6.8）就像現代的開放式辦公空間：移除隔牆後，同樣的面積容納更多工作站，協作更靈活。密閉設備的外殼就是每個「工作站」的隱形隔牆。
blocks.en: The ballroom concept (Figure 6.8) is like a modern open-plan office: with the partitions removed, the same area holds more workstations and collaboration is more flexible. The enclosure of each closed piece of equipment is the invisible partition around each "workstation".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 既有廠房改造的策略路徑
blocks.en: Key Point — Strategic Path for Retrofitting Existing Facilities

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出密閉化改造可以釋放既有廠房的產能，避免新建廠房：
blocks.en: ISPE clearly states that retrofitting for closure can free up capacity in existing facilities and avoid building new ones:

blocks.zh: 評估現有設備密閉性：無法密閉的設備阻礙 CNC 降級
blocks.en: Assess the closure of existing equipment: equipment that cannot be closed blocks downgrading to CNC

blocks.zh: 逐步引入密閉技術：優先從高頻率操作的設備開始（如收穫離心機引入 CIP/SIP）
blocks.en: Introduce closure technology step by step: start with the most frequently operated equipment (for example, introducing CIP/SIP to the harvest centrifuge)

blocks.zh: 分階段拆除隔牆：從相鄰兩間開始合并，逐步擴大
blocks.en: Remove partition walls in phases: start by merging two adjacent rooms and expand gradually

blocks.zh: 驗證新廠房配置：重新做 URS/DQ/OQ/PQ 認證
blocks.en: Qualify the new facility configuration: repeat URS/DQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: PAL/MAL 拆除後轉為生產面積，是提升廠房利用率的「隱藏紅利」。
blocks.en: Converting the area of removed PALs/MALs to production space is the "hidden dividend" for improving facility utilization.

blocks.zh: 改造效益估算 Retrofit Benefit Calculation
blocks.en: Retrofit Benefit Calculation

blocks.zh:
假設既有廠房有 4 個獨立製程房間：
  每間面積：50 m²
  PAL/MAL 面積：每間 2×10 m² = 20 m²
  總有效製程面積：4 × 50 = 200 m²

密閉化改造後（圖 6.8 概念）：
  拆除 3 道隔牆：釋放約 3 × 5 m² = 15 m²
  拆除 3 組 PAL/MAL：釋放 3 × 20 = 60 m²
  走廊降級可整合：+30 m²

新的有效製程面積：200 + 15 + 60 + 30 = 305 m²
面積增加幅度：約 +52%（不需新建廠房）
blocks.en:
Assume an existing facility has 4 separate process rooms:
  Area per room: 50 m²
  PAL/MAL area: 2×10 m² = 20 m² per room
  Total effective process area: 4 × 50 = 200 m²

After retrofitting for closure (Figure 6.8 concept):
  Removing 3 partition walls: frees about 3 × 5 m² = 15 m²
  Removing 3 sets of PAL/MAL: frees 3 × 20 = 60 m²
  Downgraded corridor can be integrated: +30 m²

New effective process area: 200 + 15 + 60 + 30 = 305 m²
Area increase: about +52% (no new building required)

blocks.zh: 圖 6.7 中，若只有製程間 (a) 降級為 CNC，但走廊仍為潔淨環境，為何這「不太可能提供切實改善」？
blocks.en: In Figure 6.7, if only the process rooms (a) are downgraded to CNC while the corridor remains a cleanroom environment, why is this "unlikely to provide a tangible improvement"?

blocks.zh: Ballroom 概念對 CDMO 的多產品同時生產有什麼風險？需要什麼管控措施？
blocks.en: What risks does the ballroom concept pose for simultaneous multi-product manufacturing in a CDMO? What controls are needed?

blocks.zh: 6.3.4 Facility Layout Overview — Six Case Studies — 廠房佈局概覽：六個案例研究
blocks.en: 6.3.4 Facility Layout Overview — Six Case Studies

Figure 6.9🔍: Room Division Case Studies

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Case 4 的兩個關鍵突破
blocks.en: Key Point — Two Key Breakthroughs in Case 4

blocks.zh: 突破一：接種準備的重新定義
blocks.en: Breakthrough 1: Redefining inoculum preparation

blocks.zh: 將接種準備（inoculum preparation）從「無菌製程（aseptic processing）」重新定義為「無菌技術（aseptic technique）」，這是概念上的重大轉變：
blocks.en: Redefining inoculum preparation from "aseptic processing" to "aseptic technique" is a major conceptual shift:

blocks.zh: 「無菌製程」需要 Grade 7 背景環境的 BSC
blocks.en: "Aseptic processing" requires a BSC in a Grade 7 background environment

blocks.zh: 「無菌技術」的「Quality BSC」不需要 Grade 7 背景，可在 Grade 8 房間操作
blocks.en: "Aseptic technique" with a "Quality BSC" does not require a Grade 7 background and can be performed in a Grade 8 room

blocks.zh: 此重新定義需要充分的科學論證和法規溝通
blocks.en: This redefinition requires sound scientific justification and regulatory dialogue

blocks.zh: 突破二：病毒前後步驟合室
blocks.en: Breakthrough 2: Pre- and post-virus steps in the same room

blocks.zh: 將「病毒去除完成」的定義點移到最終 UF/DF 步驟，讓純化的所有步驟可以在同一房間進行。
blocks.en: The point at which "virus removal is complete" is moved to the final UF/DF step, so that all purification steps can be carried out in the same room.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Case 5 的離心機問題
blocks.en: Key Point — The Centrifuge Issue in Case 5

blocks.zh: 收穫步驟的離心機在之前案例中一直獨立成房，原因有二：
blocks.en: In the earlier cases, the harvest centrifuge was always placed in its own room, for two reasons:

blocks.zh: 清潔方式：離心機需要手動暴露清洗（無 CIP），無法在 CNC 房間進行
blocks.en: Cleaning method: centrifuges needed manual cleaning with exposure (no CIP) and could not be in a CNC room

blocks.zh: 噪音（Acoustic）問題：高速離心機噪音超過可接受水平（dB 限制）
blocks.en: Acoustic issue: noise from high-speed centrifuges exceeded acceptable levels (dB limits)

blocks.zh: Case 5 中，新型離心機配備了 CIP/SIP 技術，同時改善了噪音問題，才得以加入 Ballroom。這提示設備技術進步是推動廠房設計升級的重要驅動力。
blocks.en: In Case 5, a new centrifuge with CIP/SIP technology also improved the noise problem, which allowed it to join the ballroom. This shows that advances in equipment technology are an important driver of facility design upgrades.

blocks.zh: 40% 成本差異的來源分析
blocks.en: Analysis of the Sources of the 40% Cost Difference

blocks.zh:
Case 1 vs Case 6 成本差異約 40%，來源：

建設成本差異：
  潔淨室面積大幅減少     → -15~20%
  HVAC 系統規模縮減      → -8~12%
  PAL/MAL 數量減少       → -3~5%

年度運營成本差異：
  更衣消耗品（無塵服等）→ -30~40%
  環境監測（EM）頻次     → -40~60%
  設施維護（過濾器等）   → -20~30%
  能源消耗（HVAC）       → -20~30%

人員效率提升：
  更衣時間減少           → 生產時間增加 10~15%
  物料流動簡化           → 操作效率提升
blocks.en:
The Case 1 vs Case 6 cost difference of about 40% comes from:

Construction cost differences:
  Greatly reduced cleanroom area     → -15~20%
  Smaller HVAC system                → -8~12%
  Fewer PALs/MALs                    → -3~5%

Annual operating cost differences:
  Gowning consumables (cleanroom garments etc.) → -30~40%
  Environmental monitoring (EM) frequency       → -40~60%
  Facility maintenance (filters etc.)           → -20~30%
  Energy consumption (HVAC)                     → -20~30%

Personnel efficiency gains:
  Less gowning time          → production time increases 10~15%
  Simpler material flow      → improved operating efficiency

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 六個案例如同餐廳廚房的演進
blocks.en: Analogy — The Six Cases Are Like the Evolution of a Restaurant Kitchen

blocks.zh: 想像一家餐廳廚房的演進：
blocks.en: Imagine the evolution of a restaurant kitchen:

blocks.zh: Case 1：完全開放廚房，每道菜都需要廚師穿特製防護服，每個料理台之間都有玻璃隔牆
blocks.en: Case 1: a fully open kitchen where every dish requires the chef to wear special protective clothing, with glass partitions between every cooking station

blocks.zh: Case 3-4：大多數食材都有真空包裝，開包裝和擺盤時需要局部保護
blocks.en: Case 3-4: most ingredients are vacuum-packed, and local protection is needed only when opening the packaging and plating

blocks.zh: Case 6：幾乎所有食材都密封包裝到最後才開，整個廚房只是一個通風良好的大空間，效率最高、衛生管理最容易
blocks.en: Case 6: almost all ingredients stay sealed until the last moment, and the whole kitchen is just one well-ventilated large space, with the highest efficiency and the easiest hygiene management

blocks.zh: 在 Case 4 中，若法規機構不接受「接種準備是無菌技術而非無菌製程」的論點，對廠房設計有何影響？
blocks.en: In Case 4, if the regulator does not accept the argument that "inoculum preparation is aseptic technique rather than aseptic processing", what is the impact on facility design?

blocks.zh: Case 6 中，接種準備仍可以設計到歐洲 Grade D 的 CNC 水平，這在亞太地區（台灣、日本、韓國）的法規環境下是否可行？
blocks.en: In Case 6, inoculum preparation can still be designed to a European Grade D CNC level. Is this feasible under the regulatory environment in the Asia-Pacific region (Taiwan, Japan, Korea)?

blocks.zh: 為何「廠房可以成為 CNC 區域產品的非關鍵面向（non-critical aspect system）」是一個重要的法規策略聲明？
blocks.en: Why is "the facility can be a non-critical aspect system for products in CNC areas" an important regulatory strategy statement?

blocks.zh: 6.3.5 Flexible Facility Ballrooms — 彈性廠房 Ballroom 概念
blocks.en: 6.3.5 Flexible Facility Ballrooms

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Ballroom 的完整設計要素
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Complete Design Elements of a Ballroom

blocks.zh: 一個完整的 Ballroom 設施包含：
blocks.en: A complete ballroom facility includes:

blocks.zh: 核心 Ballroom（CNC）：所有密閉製程設備（生物反應器、純化設備、緩衝液系統）
blocks.en: Core ballroom (CNC): all closed process equipment (bioreactors, purification equipment, buffer systems)

blocks.zh: 衛星潔淨室（Grade 8）：無法密閉的步驟，如柱填充（column packing），通過氣閘連接到 Ballroom
blocks.en: Satellite cleanrooms (Grade 8): steps that cannot be closed, such as column packing, connected to the ballroom through an airlock

blocks.zh: 設備清洗室：獨立區域，可為 CNC 或 Grade 8（取決於清洗後的設備用途）
blocks.en: Equipment wash room: a separate area, which may be CNC or Grade 8 (depending on the use of the equipment after cleaning)

blocks.zh: 更衣設施（最小化）：CNC 區域更衣要求大幅低於潔淨室，節省空間
blocks.en: Gowning facilities (minimized): gowning requirements for CNC areas are far lower than for cleanrooms, saving space

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 一次性耗材與不鏽鋼均相容
blocks.en: Key Point — Single-Use and Stainless Steel Are Both Compatible

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調 Ballroom 概念不依賴特定設備材質，一次性耗材（SU）和不鏽鋼設備都能在 Ballroom 概念下運作，前提是設備必須達到功能密閉（functionally closed）狀態。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically emphasizes that the ballroom concept does not depend on a particular equipment material. Both single-use (SU) and stainless steel equipment can work under the ballroom concept, provided the equipment achieves a functionally closed state.

blocks.zh: 這對於正在考慮從 SU 技術過渡到大規模不鏽鋼的 CDMO 是重要信息：廠房本身不需要重建，只需確保新設備的密閉性。
blocks.en: This is important information for a CDMO considering a transition from SU technology to large-scale stainless steel: the facility itself does not need to be rebuilt, only the closure of the new equipment needs to be ensured.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Ballroom 如同現代化的無人工廠
blocks.en: Analogy — The Ballroom Is Like a Modern Automated Factory

blocks.zh: 現代汽車工廠的生產線是開放式的大空間，不同工序的機械手臂在同一廠房中並行工作，靠機器人精準操作實現隔離，而不是靠牆壁。
blocks.en: The production line of a modern car factory is a large open space, where robotic arms for different operations work in parallel in the same hall, achieving segregation through precise robot operation rather than walls.

blocks.zh: Ballroom 概念正是如此：密閉設備的外殼就是「機器人手臂的精準邊界」，房間只是一個提供基礎環境管控（溫濕度、換氣）的外殼，不再是 GMP 隔離的主要工具。
blocks.en: The ballroom concept is exactly this: the enclosure of the closed equipment is the "precise boundary of the robotic arm", and the room is just a shell that provides basic environmental control (temperature and humidity, air changes), no longer the main tool of GMP segregation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 選擇 Ballroom 設計的商業考量
blocks.en: Practical Application — Commercial Considerations for a CDMO Choosing a Ballroom Design

blocks.zh: 對於規劃新建或改造廠房的 CDMO：
blocks.en: For a CDMO planning a new facility or a retrofit:

blocks.zh: 初始投資：Ballroom 廠房建設成本比多房間設計低 20-40%
blocks.en: Initial investment: ballroom construction cost is 20-40% lower than a multi-room design

blocks.zh: 運營彈性：同一空間可快速重新配置設備，應對不同客戶需求
blocks.en: Operational flexibility: the same space can be quickly reconfigured with equipment to meet different client needs

blocks.zh: 擴充性：只需增加設備，不需新建隔牆和潔淨室認證
blocks.en: Expandability: only equipment needs to be added, with no new partition walls or cleanroom certification

blocks.zh: 監管風險：需要完整的 CCS（污染控制策略）和完善的 SU 管理程序
blocks.en: Regulatory risk: requires a complete CCS (contamination control strategy) and robust SU management procedures

blocks.zh: 法規文件：URS 必須清楚描述密閉性要求，MAA/BLA 中需論證 CNC 的合理性
blocks.en: Regulatory documentation: the URS must clearly describe closure requirements, and the MAA/BLA must justify the CNC grade

blocks.zh: Ballroom 設計中，若某個生物反應器的密封件失效導致短暫開放，應如何應對？SOP 中需要有哪些規定？
blocks.en: In a ballroom design, how should a brief opening caused by a failed seal on a bioreactor be handled? What provisions are needed in the SOP?

blocks.zh: 一個 10,000 L Ballroom（5 × 2,000 L SU 生物反應器）如果要擴大到 20,000 L 產能，有哪些設計選項？各自的廠房影響是什麼？
blocks.en: If a 10,000 L ballroom (5 × 2,000 L SU bioreactors) is to be expanded to 20,000 L capacity, what design options are there? What is the facility impact of each?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary — Chapter 6A Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Chapter Summary — Chapter 6A Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 廠房設計的推導邏輯：從商業產能目標 → BFD/PFD → 製程密閉程度決策 → 隔離策略 → 廠房佈局，每一步都有明確的邏輯聯繫。
blocks.en: Derivation logic of facility design: from commercial capacity target → BFD/PFD → process closure decision → segregation strategy → facility layout, with a clear logical link at every step.

blocks.zh: 規模對廠房的影響：大規模（>10,000 L）傾向垂直堆疊五層設計；小規模（≤2,000 L）使用一次性耗材，水平排列於單一生產層，可大幅縮減廠房面積。
blocks.en: Effect of scale on the facility: large scale (>10,000 L) tends toward a five-level vertical stack-up design; small scale (≤2,000 L) uses single-use consumables arranged horizontally on a single production floor, which greatly reduces the facility area.

blocks.zh: 四種隔離概念：物理、環境、時間、程序隔離各有其適用場景。密閉製程最大的設計紅利是將物理隔離從「房間層面」下移到「設備層面」，使廠房從多個潔淨室演進為單一 CNC Ballroom。
blocks.en: Four segregation concepts: physical, environmental, temporal and procedural segregation each have their own applications. The biggest design dividend of closed processing is moving physical segregation down from the "room level" to the "equipment level", so that the facility evolves from multiple cleanrooms to a single CNC ballroom.

blocks.zh: 六個案例的核心訊息：Case 1（全開放 Grade 7）到 Case 6（全密閉 CNC Ballroom）的建設與運營成本差距約 40%。密閉程度越高，廠房越簡單、越便宜、越靈活。
blocks.en: Core message of the six cases: the construction and operating cost gap from Case 1 (fully open, Grade 7) to Case 6 (fully closed, CNC ballroom) is about 40%. The higher the degree of closure, the simpler, cheaper and more flexible the facility.

blocks.zh: CNC 概念的重要性：CNC 不是「沒有環境管控」，而是「有管控但不符合 ISO 粒子計數分級」。對於完全密閉製程，CNC 是合理且法規接受的空間等級。
blocks.en: Importance of the CNC concept: CNC does not mean "no environmental control" but "controlled but not classified by ISO particle counts". For a fully closed process, CNC is a reasonable and regulator-accepted space grade.

blocks.zh: 雙重保護壓力：生物製藥廠房面對「保護產品（潔淨室設計）」和「保護人員/環境（圍堵設計）」兩個競爭需求。製程密閉是同時滿足兩者的最佳策略。
blocks.en: Dual protection pressures: a biopharmaceutical facility faces two competing needs, "protecting the product (cleanroom design)" and "protecting personnel/environment (containment design)". Process closure is the best strategy for satisfying both at once.

blocks.zh: 在線稀釋 + SU 技術：緩衝液在線稀釋可將緩衝液儲存空間縮減 60-80%，結合一次性耗材可進一步壓縮廠房面積，是現代 CDMO 的首選技術組合。
blocks.en: In-line dilution + SU technology: in-line buffer dilution can reduce buffer storage space by 60-80%, and combined with single-use consumables can further compress the facility footprint, making it the preferred technology combination for a modern CDMO.
